summary_en.motivation: To develop ultrahigh-strength titanium porous scaffolds with mechanical properties matching those of bone for orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Gyroid scaffolds were fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM) and subjected to mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The scaffolds exhibited ultrahigh compressive strength and elastic modulus comparable to human bone.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through compression tests.

papers.title: On the influence of laser defocusing in Selective Laser Melting of 316L
papers.abstract: Despite its many benefits, Selective Laser Melting's (SLM) relatively low productivity compared to deposition-based additive manufacturing techniques is a major drawback. Increasing the laser beam diameter improves SLM's build rate, but causes loss of precision. The aim of this study is to investigate laser beam focus shift, or “defocus”, using a dynamic focusing unit, in order to increase the laser spot size. When applied to the SLM process, focus shift can be integrated into a “hull-core” strategy. This involves scanning the core with a high productivity parameter set using defocus while enabling return to the focused smaller spot size position for hull scanning. To assess the process stability, single line scans were made from 316L stainless steel powder. The consolidated melt pool morphology was analyzed and correlated with the process parameters comprising laser power, scanning speed and defocus distance. In order to link the melt pool morphology with the heat input, Volumetric Energy Density, Normalized Enthalpy and Rosenthal equation were considered. The suitability of using the Normalized Enthalpy as a design parameter to predict the melt pool depth and Rosenthal equation to predict its width was highlighted. This study shows that within a single laser setup, implementing defocus can lead to a potential productivity increase by 840%, i.e. to 18.8 mm3/s.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高SLM工艺的生产率，同时保持精度。
summary_zh.method: 通过动态聚焦单元实现激光束离焦，采用壳-芯策略扫描。
summary_zh.result: 离焦使生产率提高840%，达到18.8 mm³/s。
summary_zh.validation: 单道扫描实验，分析熔池形貌并与热输入模型对比。

summary_en.motivation: To increase the build rate of Selective Laser Melting while maintaining precision by using laser beam defocusing.
summary_en.method: A dynamic focusing unit was employed to shift the laser focus, enabling a hull-core scanning strategy with defocused core and focused hull.
summary_en.result: Defocusing increased productivity by 840% to 18.8 mm³/s for 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.validation: Single line scans were performed and melt pool morphology was correlated with process parameters and thermal models.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: University Technology Centre for Computational Engineering, University of Southampton, Southampton SO16 7QF, UK

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注SLM工艺中的成本优化和零件排样，未涉及生物医学植入物的力学性能或材料特性。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on manufacturing cost optimization and bin packing for SLM, with no mention of porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM工艺中的零件定向和排样以降低成本
summary_zh.method: 建立成本模型并采用优化算法求解定向和排样问题
summary_zh.result: 实现了制造成本的显著降低
summary_zh.validation: 通过案例研究验证优化效果

summary_en.motivation: To reduce manufacturing costs in Selective Laser Melting by optimizing part orientation and bin packing.
summary_en.method: A cost model integrating build time, support structure, and post-processing costs is formulated and solved using optimization algorithms.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach achieves significant cost reductions compared to manual orientation and packing.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through case studies on representative industrial parts.

papers.title: Mechanical responses of titanium 3D kagome lattice structure manufactured by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Advanced Design and Manufacturing for Vehicle Body, Hunan University, Changsha, Hunan, 410082, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Haiqiong Xie
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Chongqing 400065, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了通过选择性激光熔化制造的钛合金Kagome点阵结构的力学响应，与用户关注的增材制造生物医用植入物的力学性能高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造的钛合金Kagome点阵的力学性能，以用于轻量化或生物医学植入物。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备不同相对密度的Kagome点阵试样，并进行准静态压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: Kagome点阵表现出优异的比强度和能量吸收能力，失效模式为逐层屈曲。
summary_zh.validation: 实验压缩测试与有限元模拟结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical responses of titanium Kagome lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting for potential lightweight or biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Kagome lattice specimens with varying relative densities were fabricated via SLM and subjected to quasi-static compression tests.
summary_en.result: The Kagome lattice exhibited high specific strength and energy absorption, with a layer-by-layer buckling failure mode.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests were validated against finite element simulations.
